name: Gian Piero Gasperini

spellsCounted.reason: Day of appointment not found (summer 2006), 1 July used. Serie B promotion 2007, 5th in Serie A 2008/09 and Europa League, recognisable 3-4-3, Mourinho praise, led to Inter job.

Rebuilt Genoa (13th 2013/14) with 3-4-3 and high pressing, move to Atalanta; end date approximate (end of 2015/16 season, exact day of departure not confirmed; Atalanta appointment 2016-06-14). Little tactical coverage in sources read, so these two Genoa spells are weighted by the same test but thinly evidenced.

Core spell: Europa League 2023/24, Champions League qualifications, youth/player-development pipeline, 3-4-1-2/3-4-2-1 with man-oriented pressing. End date is the 31 May 2025 farewell letter (official club statement 1 June 2025).
Third place and Champions League spot in 2025/26; man-marking press and 3-4-2-1 tactical coverage. Still in post per search results to mid-October 2026 (not confirmed after).

spellsExcluded.reason: Serie C1/B, thin tactical coverage; sacked Dec 2004 and recalled Apr 2005; dates are approximate (it.wikipedia: summer 2003 to 2006).
Under 15 competitive matches (about 5-6 matches, one Supercoppa, Serie A and Champions League games).
About 22 league matches with a sack (4 Feb 2013) and return (24 Feb) but no recognisable tactical coverage or title; 17 points in 22 games.

scopeNote: Covers Genoa 2006-10 and 2013-16, Atalanta 2016-25 and Roma 2025-ongoing. Style named by sources: 3-4-3 / 3-4-1-2 / 3-4-2-1 back three with wing-backs, 'man-orientated' or 'man-to-man pressing' with man-marking across the pitch (Wikipedia, Chiesa di Totti, Left Back Football, UEFA). Marking is not purely man: Left Back Football describes a switch to zonal in a 5-3-2 block, Coaches' Voice describes a mid-block, and Gasperini himself denied that Mandragora man-marked Pogba in 2014. Popular label 'gegenpressing' is a blog label, not verified. Evidence is thick for Atalanta 2018-21 and Roma 2025/26, thin for Genoa spells, Atalanta 2022-25 (Europa League final analysis by UEFA was not accessible) and Roma after Jan 2026. Partial dates: Genoa 2006 start day and Genoa 2016 end day not found.
openQuestions: How strict is the man-marking over time? Left Back Football (2018/19) shows a switch to a zonal 5-3-2 shape; Chiesa di Totti (Jan 2026) says man-marking is still the defining feature; Gasperini said in 2014 the press reports of Mandragora marking Pogba were false.
Gomez clash 2021: Gomez says Gasperini tried to physically attack him, Gasperini says the attack came from Gomez. Unresolved, both attributed.
Whether Gasperini is still Roma coach on 2026-11-06: searches show him in post to mid-October 2026, not checked after.
Exact dates: Genoa appointment (summer 2006), Genoa 2016 departure, Atalanta departure (31 May vs 1 June 2025).

Whether Atalanta's set-piece weakness (43% of goals conceded from dead balls in 2023/24) is a trait or a one-season figure; attacking set-piece xG (StatsBomb 2019/20) was seen only in a search summary.
Wikipedia 2026 text cited here may have been updated after the period; used for dates only.
